limitations: The capture helper reported CANDIDATE_URL_OCR_UNVERIFIED_REVIEW_REQUIRED for every source because the native window did not show the URL.
The compact profile picker crop ends immediately after the rounded choice panel to exclude the unrelated next property; review its lower edge in the full rendered article.
The two focused editor crops split the original pane into name and footer controls; neither crop demonstrates a saved rename or deletion.
The bulk-lists closeup shows the two-customer selection count and Lists control. The separate confirmation crop shows selected fictitious rows and the staged list change.

The native bulk and delete confirmation screenshots show authentic application row and pane separator lines behind the rounded modals; these are not crop, resampling, or image-editing artifacts. Tighter rectangular crops were rejected because they still included lines or cut the complete modal border/shadow; a new UI capture over a cleaner background is needed if those lines are unacceptable in the rendered guide.
